messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: rstan traceplot fails with unconstrain=TRUE
parts:
Hi!

The new rstan 2.8.0 looks really cool I have to say some nice features. It looks like I ran into a bug with the traceplot command:

R3.0.2> traceplot(fit, unconstrain=TRUE)
Error: mismatch in number dimensions declared and found in context; processing stage=initialization; variable name=beta; dims declared=(1); dims found=()

beta is vector of length 1 in my model.

Sebastian

messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: Re: rstan traceplot fails with unconstrain=TRUE
parts:
Hi Sebastian, 

Thanks for reporting. I think you probably found a bug in unconstrain_pars rather than traceplot (which just calls unconstrain_pars). I'll open an issue on GitHub and we'll look into it further. 

Jonah

messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: [stan-users] Re: rstan traceplot fails with unconstrain=TRUE
parts: This particularly issue should be fixed, but it was pointed out in the comments on the GitHub issue that there are still a few cases when specifying unconstrain=TRUE will throw an error because unconstrain_pars can't be called when a stanfit object is created from reading in csv files or a saved stanfit object (eg from an .RData file). I'll try to add some warnings for those cases so it doesn't just fail mysteriously.
